ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure containing Ph3P; on the left, Ph3P⁺ is connected to a nitrogen, this nitrogen is also connected to CO2Et, and forms an N–N bond with another nitrogen on the right; the right-side nitrogen is connected to H and EtO2C. Below there is an alcohol/substrate portion, shown as :OH connected to a carbon, and this carbon is further connected to R1 and R2; there are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: Count according to the specified segments and exclude hydrogen-related bonds. Ph3P is expanded as 3 phenyl groups, and each phenyl group has 6 intra-ring heavy-atom bonds and 1 P–C bond, so Ph3P = 3 × (6 + 1) = 21. Then add 1 P–N bond and 1 N–N bond. The two ester substituents CO2Et/EtO2C each contain 5 heavy-atom bonds, so they are 2 × 5 = 10. In the lower alcohol/substrate portion, count only O–C, C–R1, and C–R2, for a total of 3; do not count N–H and O–H. Total = 21 + 1 + 1 + 10 + 3 = 36.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Expand the shorthand groups and count by fragments. Count Ph3P as 3 × (6 phenyl ring bonds + 1 P–C bond) = 21, then add P–N = 1 and N–N = 1. Count the two ester substituents as 2 × 5 = 10 heavy-atom bonds. Count the lower alcohol/substrate part as O–C, C–R1, and C–R2 = 3 bonds. Do not count N–H or O–H, and ignore arrows. Sum these contributions to get the total.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个含 Ph3P 的过渡态结构，左侧有 Ph3P⁺ 与一个氮相连，该氮还连有 CO2Et，并与右侧另一个氮形成 N–N 键；右侧氮连有 H 和 EtO2C。下方有一个醇/底物部分，显示为 :OH 连到一个碳，该碳再连 R1 和 R2；图中还有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：按指定分段计数并排除氢相关键。Ph3P 展开为 3 个苯基，每个苯基有 6 个环内重原子键和 1 个 P–C 键，所以 Ph3P = 3 × (6 + 1) = 21。再加 P–N 键 1 个、N–N 键 1 个。两个酯取代基 CO2Et/EtO2C 各含 5 个重原子键，所以为 2 × 5 = 10。下方醇/底物部分只计 O–C、C–R1、C–R2，共 3 个；不计 N–H 和 O–H。总数 = 21 + 1 + 1 + 10 + 3 = 36。

method.method_draft: Make a heavy-atom adjacency checklist. List 18 phenyl ring edges for the three Ph rings, 3 P–phenyl attachment edges, 1 P–N edge, and 1 N–N edge. For each of the two ester groups list five edges: N–C carbonyl, C=O, C–O, O–ethyl carbon, and ethyl C–C, giving 10 more. For the lower fragment list O–central C, central C–R1, and central C–R2. Add the edge counts from the checklist; because each adjacency is recorded once, no bond is double-counted.
